name: com.previewfix/previewfix
title: PreviewFix
description: Free live previews and human-paid checkout links for fixed-price business audits and compliance.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List business services currently offered for sale on PreviewFix, with prices, turnaround, and accepted preview input fields.

category.description: Optional service category filter (e.g. email-security, accessibility, eu-compliance, ai-visibility, data-conversion, procurement, site-reliability).

tools.name: run_preview
tools.description: Run a free live preview for a sellable service (same validation, vertical screening, SSRF protection, rate limits, and per-preview cost cap as /api/preview, plus a per-service daily budget cap). Returns a preview token, summary blocks, and solveUrl.

slug.description: Service slug from list_services (for example: dmarc-fix-pack, wcag-eaa-audit, geo-ai-visibility, booking-patch-desk, dpp-peppol, tender-bid-readiness).

input.description: Key-value input fields matching the service's inputFields from list_services (binary file upload fields are web-only).

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Retrieve an existing preview result and summary blocks using the token returned by run_preview.

token.description: The 16–32 character preview token returned by run_preview.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Create an order and return a hosted Stripe checkout URL (or PayPal when enabled) for a preview token. Never charges automatically — hand the returned checkoutUrl to the human buyer so they can review and pay in a browser.

email.description: Buyer's email address for delivery and receipt.

variant.description: Optional variant key from list_services (defaults to the service's primary variant).

provider.description: Hosted payment provider (default: stripe; paypal only when enabled).

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Check status, progress events, and expiring deliverable download links for an order. Strictly requires BOTH the order reference and the matching preview token.

reference.description: The order reference returned by get_checkout_link (e.g. PR-7K2M9Q).

token.description: The matching preview token from run_preview that created this order.
